decisionsTitle: «Contract semnat»: the signed copy of a volunteer's agreement, attached to their record, kept privately in the database (amending §758)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-19, from his phone:** «trebuie pentru fiecare voluntar să pot atașa „contract semnat”» — *for every volunteer I must be able to attach the "signed contract"*. The volunteer agreements of Saturday's race (2026-11-21) were printed with the Association's column and signed by the club's president; the owner holds one Word file per volunteer, named «Contract-voluntariat-<Nume>.docx» with the name ASCII-folded («Contract-voluntariat-Anais-Meyson.docx» for «Anaïs Meyson»; a minor's file holds the volunteer's entry and the parent's), and will also have scans or photos of paper ones. Amends §758: the agreement is still accepted on the form, by the link or on paper; its signed copy is now kept beside it.

**Decision — in the database, never in the bucket.** A signed agreement carries a signature and personal data, and the media bucket's reads are public (`SETUP.md`: «Reads are public because the gallery is»): nothing kept there is private. So the file is a row of PostgreSQL, `event_volunteer_documents` (migration `0220`, expand only, generated by drizzle-kit): the volunteer (`ON DELETE CASCADE`), the name as uploaded (cleaned of a path, of control characters and of the marks that turn a line's direction, at most 200 characters), the format, the length, the bytes as `bytea`, who attached it (`ON DELETE SET NULL`) and when. **One per volunteer** (`UNIQUE (volunteer_id)`): attaching another replaces it, in the same statement. It leaves the site only through an authenticated route, `GET /api/admin/events/<id>/volunteers/<volunteerId>/signed-contract`: the session and the volunteers' role asked again, an attachment under the uploaded name made safe (`content-disposition.ts`; the format's extension added when the name does not say it), the format's own type, `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Cache-Control: private, no-store` — never a public address. One module reads the table (`modules/volunteers/signed-contract.ts`), and `tests/unit/volunteers/signed-contract-never-leaves.test.ts` keeps the list of the files that may import it.

**What a file may be.** At most 10 MB; a PDF, a Word file (DOCX, or the older DOC), a JPEG, a PNG or a phone's HEIC/HEIF — **read from the file's own bytes**, never from its name or the type the browser claimed: the JPEG and PNG signatures; a ZIP holding `[Content_Types].xml` and a `word/` folder (an Excel or a plain archive is not one); a compound file holding a `WordDocument` stream (an old Excel is not one); an ISO media file whose brands say HEIC or HEIF (an AVIF is neither); `%PDF-` within the first kilobyte, read last. A photograph named «contract.pdf» is kept as the JPEG it is, under its own name, and downloads as «contract.pdf.jpg». Each refusal has its own code — `VOLUNTEER_CONTRACT_EMPTY`, `VOLUNTEER_CONTRACT_TOO_LARGE`, `VOLUNTEER_CONTRACT_TYPE` — and writes nothing.

**Ten megabytes, on a host that takes 4.5 MB a request (§66).** The page's island sends a larger file in pieces of 4 MB, the house's browser send limit (`media/limits.ts#BROWSER_SEND_BYTES`): the first piece declares the whole length — refused at once past 10 MB, or when its first bytes open like no format —, each next one is appended in order to `event_volunteer_document_uploads` (one upload under way per volunteer: a newer one replaces a half-sent one; a piece out of turn, sent twice, or for an upload gone is `VOLUNTEER_CONTRACT_UPLOAD_GONE`), and the last one moves the whole file, checked whole by its bytes, into the volunteer's copy in the same transaction, the pieces deleted. A half-sent upload is read by nothing and goes with the volunteer. With scripts off the card is a plain multipart form posting the whole file (as large as the host takes in one request) and coming back to the person's page: 303, the toast in the flash cookie, a refusal's code in the address. The download is sent as a stream, a megabyte at a time. Multipart is parsed by the platform's own `Request.formData()`: no dependency.

**On the volunteer's page**, right under the person's block, where the agreement's acceptance is said: the card «Contract semnat» / “Signed agreement”. None yet: the file box and «Încarcă». One there: its name, its length, when and by whom; «Descarcă»; «Înlocuiește» (the same box: the new file takes the old one's place); «Șterge», behind the house's question. An open card, never a fold: the upload with scripts off comes back to it (`#contract-semnat`). A file attached does **not** mark the agreement accepted: the acceptance stays the form's, the link's or «Semnat pe hârtie» (a question for the owner).

**All at once — «Încarcă contractele semnate»**, on the «Voluntari» list with one event in scope: a multiple-file box. Each file is matched to **one** volunteer of **that** event by the name it carries: its extensions, a browser's « (1)» and a leading «Contract-voluntariat-» / «Contract voluntariat» / «Contract de voluntariat» in any case are taken off; both names are folded by the house's name fold (`name-fold.ts`: case, the diacritics in either spelling — ș/ş, ț/ţ, ă, â, î, ï —, the characters nobody sees), every mark that is not a letter or a digit read as a space; compared first exactly and, only when nobody has the name in that order, as the same words in another order («Popescu-Ion» for «Ion Popescu»), among the event's volunteers who are not cancelled. Exactly one is attached, replacing an older copy. Two or more is «mai mulți voluntari ai evenimentului au acest nume», nobody «niciun voluntar al evenimentului nu are acest nume», only a cancelled volunteer «numele e al unui voluntar anulat», a person an earlier file of the same upload matched «alt fișier din aceeași încărcare e deja al acestui voluntar» — **never attached, never a guess**, and a volunteer of another event is never a candidate. With scripts the names alone go first (`answer=json`), so a file nobody matches never goes up, then each matched file goes to its volunteer's own route, one request a file (pieces for a large one), so one bad file never stops the others; the answer says how many were attached and lists the rest by file name with the reason — in the page, never in an address. With scripts off the form posts every file, each matched one is attached in a transaction of its own, and the toast says how many were and were not: counts only, since a file's name carries a person's.

**On the list:** the chip «Contract semnat» on each row whose copy is attached (`status-glyphs.ts#signedContract`); «Contracte semnate: N din M» on the strip, over «Înscris» and «Confirmat» — a cancelled person owes none —, a pill to exactly those people; and the filter «Contract semnat»: with one, without one (who is left after a folder), everyone (`contract=yes|no`). The list reads only whether a copy exists, one read for the page's rows. «Toate datele unei persoane» lists each offer's copy — its name, its format, its length and when, never its bytes (art. 15 GDPR) — and its file's export counts them.

**Roles.** Whoever works the volunteers (`canManageVolunteers`: the Organizer, the Administrator and the Superadministrator) attaches, downloads, replaces and deletes; asserted on the server by both routes, the delete action and every function of the service (BR-REQ-060-01). No session is 401; the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer and a member are 403 (`FORBIDDEN` from the service), and see nothing of it — both pages are already a 404 for them; another event's volunteer, a malformed or an unknown id is 404. A refusal writes nothing.

**Erasure and retention.** The copy lives as long as the volunteer's row and not a moment longer: «Șterge voluntarul», the thirty-day retention sweep (`jobs/retention.ts`, step `volunteers`) and an event's hard delete take it, with any upload of it half-sent, by the tables' `ON DELETE CASCADE`, in the same statement. **The trail** — `volunteer.signed_contract_uploaded`, `…_replaced` (with the old length and format), `…_deleted` and `…_downloaded` — names the volunteer's id, the file's length and its format, **never the file's name**, which carries the person's, and never a byte.

**The database's size.** Small and few: one file per volunteer of an event, a Word file a few hundred kilobytes, a scan a few megabytes, ten at most. A race of sixty volunteers is a few megabytes; the impossible worst case, sixty files of ten, is 600 MB, which Neon's Launch bills at $0.35 a GB-month — about 21 cents, for the thirty days the rows live. The governor (§447) reads compute, not storage; «Mărimea bazei de date» and `yarn db:sizes` show the table among the largest if it ever is. The bytes are read only by the download and by the last piece of an upload.

**Refused.** The media bucket: its reads are public. A file standing for the agreement's acceptance: the copy is the club's record, the acceptance is the person's (§758's three ways stay). A match across events, among the cancelled, or by a guess when two people share a name. The volunteers' Excel column «Contract semnat: Da/Nu», optional in the brief: it would rewrite the export's column-exact tests, and the list's «Fără contract semnat» says the same in one press.
changelogLine: - **«Contract semnat» for every volunteer** — attach the signed copy of a volunteer's agreement (PDF, Word, JPEG, PNG or a phone's HEIC, up to 10 MB) on their page, then download, replace or delete it; or upload a whole folder of «Contract-voluntariat-<Nume>.docx» files at once from the «Voluntari» list, each attached to the event's volunteer whose name it carries and the rest listed with the reason. The list shows a «Contract semnat» chip, «Contracte semnate: N din M» and a filter for who still has none. Kept privately in the database, never in the public bucket, and deleted with the volunteer. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a volunteer's page, when the Organizer or an Administrator attaches a file under «Contract semnat», then a PDF, a DOCX or DOC, a JPEG, a PNG or a HEIC/HEIF of at most 10 MB — read from the file's own bytes, never its name or the browser's type — is kept in the database (`event_volunteer_documents`, never the media bucket), one per volunteer, a second one replacing the first; an empty file, one past 10 MB and one whose bytes are none of the formats are refused each with its own code, nothing written; the card then names the file, its length, when and by whom, with «Descarcă», «Înlocuiește» and «Șterge» behind the house's question; with scripts off the plain multipart form attaches and comes back to the page, and with scripts a file larger than one request goes up in pieces of at most 4 MB, appended in order and checked whole when the last arrives (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Descarcă» on «Contract semnat», then the file comes from an authenticated route as an attachment under the name it was uploaded with, made safe — the format's extension added when the name does not say it —, typed by its format, with `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff` and `Cache-Control: private, no-store`, its bytes as they were uploaded; never a public address (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Încarcă contractele semnate» on the «Voluntari» list of one event, when several files are chosen, then each is attached to the one volunteer of that event, not cancelled, whose name it carries — its extensions and a leading «Contract-voluntariat-» in any case taken off; case, the diacritics in either spelling («Anaïs», «Mușat», «Țâmpu») and punctuation folded; the same words in another order only when nobody has them in the file's —, and a file matching two volunteers, none, only a cancelled one, or a person an earlier file of the same upload matched is listed with its reason and never attached; a volunteer of another event is never matched; a file refused by its bytes never stops the others; the answer says how many were attached and lists the rest by file name, never in an address (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the «Voluntari» list, then a row whose signed agreement is attached wears «Contract semnat», the strip says «Contracte semnate: N din M» over «Înscris» and «Confirmat» — a pill to exactly those people, a nought said too —, and the filter «Contract semnat» lists those with one or those without one, the cancelled in neither half (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Contract semnat»'s two routes, its «Șterge» and its service, when anyone but the Organizer, an Administrator or a Superadministrator asks, then the server refuses (`FORBIDDEN` / 403; with no session, 401), another event's volunteer or a malformed id is `NOT_FOUND`, and a refusal writes nothing; each upload, replace, delete and download writes one audit row with the volunteer's id, the file's length and its format, never the file's name or a byte of it (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a volunteer's signed agreement, then it is deleted with the volunteer — «Șterge voluntarul», the thirty-day retention sweep and an event's hard delete, with any upload of it left half-sent —, it is on no public page, email, badge or bucket, and «Toate datele unei persoane» lists its name, format, length and moment beside the offer, never its bytes, its file counting them (2026-11-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: «Contract semnat»: each volunteer's signed agreement attached privately, one by one or a whole folder at once by name
